data.text:
🌄 25 Sunrises Around the World Worth Waking Up at 4AM For:

1. 🇮🇩 Mount Bromo, Indonesia — pink sky over a smoking volcanic crater
2. 🇹🇿 Serengeti, Tanzania — sun rising over vast plains teeming with wildlife at dawn
3. 🇨🇳 Zhangjiajie, China — sandstone pillars emerging from morning mist
4. 🇬🇷 Santorini, Greece — golden light hitting white domes above the Aegean
5. 🇵🇪 Machu Picchu, Peru — clouds lifting to reveal an ancient Inca city
6. 🇺🇸 Grand Canyon, USA — canyon walls turning from black to blazing orange
7. 🇲🇲 Bagan, Myanmar — hot air balloons rising over thousands of ancient temples
8. 🇰🇭 Angkor Wat, Cambodia — reflected in still water at the break of dawn
9. 🇮🇸 Iceland — midnight sun and Arctic light that shifts the sky in ways cameras cannot capture
10. 🇲🇦 Sahara Desert, Morocco — silence, sand dunes and the first light of day
11. 🇹🇷 Cappadocia, Turkey — dozens of hot air balloons floating over fairy chimneys at first light
12. 🇰🇪 Mount Kenya, Kenya — Africa's second highest peak blushing red at dawn
13. 🇦🇺 Uluru, Australia — the sacred red rock glowing like fire as the sun climbs
14. 🇳🇵 Poon Hill, Nepal — the entire Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges painted gold in minutes
15. 🇿🇦 Cape Point, South Africa — dramatic cliffs where the Atlantic coastline meets the morning sky
16. 🇧🇴 Salar de Uyuni, Bolivia — the world's largest salt flat becomes a mirror for the sky
17. 🇵🇭 Chocolate Hills, Bohol, Philippines — more than 1,200 cone-shaped hills turning amber at sunrise
18. 🇫🇷 Mont Saint-Michel, France — medieval island abbey rising from morning tidal flats and coastal fog
19. 🇹🇿 Mount Kilimanjaro, Tanzania — watching dawn from above the clouds at 5,895 metres
20. 🇯🇵 Mount Fuji, Japan — Japan's most iconic peak perfectly framed in soft morning light
21. 🇯🇴 Wadi Rum, Jordan — rose-red desert canyon walls set ablaze by the first light of morning
22. 🇨🇱 Torres del Paine, Chile — granite towers turning from deep purple to blazing gold
23. 🇪🇬 Valley of the Kings, Luxor, Egypt — desert silence broken only by the rising sun over ancient royal tombs
24. 🇨🇭 Matterhorn, Switzerland — the Alps' most iconic peak catching the very first rays of light
25. 🇮🇩 Mount Rinjani, Lombok, Indonesia — crater lake glowing turquoise as the sun rises above the rim
